factory.name: Gantt.create
factory.signature: Gantt.create(host: HTMLElement, options: GanttOptions): Gantt; scheduleGantt(tasks, dependencies, calendar: BusinessCalendarEngine, index?: WorkIndex): GanttSchedule; resourceLoad(tasks, schedule, resources, calendar, range: { start: PlainDate; end: PlainDate }): GanttResourceLoad[]; createsCycle(dependencies, from, to): boolean; assertGantt(tasks, dependencies, resources): void

options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the tree grid; the toolbar is named '{label} controls'. Non-empty.

options.name: tasks
options.description: Tasks: { id, parentId (summary task id or null), label, start (requested start, PlainDate), duration (working days, 0 = milestone), progress? (0..100), manual?, assignments? ({ resourceId, units? percent }), baseline? ({ start, end } inclusive), color? (1..8), readOnly?, collapsed? }. Tasks with children are summary tasks (their start and duration are ignored). Order within a parent is the array order. Validated (GANTT_OPTIONS). Replacing it clears the undo history.

options.name: dependencies
options.description: { id, from (predecessor), to (successor), type? ('FS' default, 'SS', 'FF', 'SF'), lag? (working days, negative = lead) }. Leaf tasks only, one per pair, no cycles (the error names the cycle).

options.name: resources
options.description: { id, label, capacity? (percent per working day, default 100) }; assignments must reference them.

options.name: calendar
options.description: Working days, holidays, and exceptions (default Monday to Friday). Durations and lags count its working days; non-working days are shaded.

options.name: editable
options.description: Pointer, keyboard, and toolbar editing (move, resize, link).

options.name: columns
options.description: Grid columns: 'name' first, then any of 'start', 'end', 'duration', 'progress', 'resources', 'float' (unique).

options.name: showCritical
options.description: Mark critical tasks (badge, hatched bar, red connectors).

options.name: showBaselines
options.description: Draw baselines and describe baseline variance in the grid.

options.name: showHistogram
options.description: Show the resource load histogram below the chart (needs resources): daily load per resource with peak and over-capacity days as text.

options.name: today
options.description: Date of the today line and the Go to today button (default: the device's local date).

options.name: canEdit
options.description: Veto edits of a task (also as a link successor). Summary and read-only tasks are never edited.

options.name: scale
options.description: Timeline scale (32, 16, or 5 CSS px per day); also changed by the zoom buttons and setScale().

options.name: rowHeight
options.description: Row height in CSS px (24..96). Rows have a fixed height (virtual rows).

options.name: locale
options.description: Dates, numbers, the first day of the week (week scale), plural forms, and messages.

options.name: direction
options.description: Mirrors the timeline and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: schedule
properties.description: Scheduled dates, float, critical flags, violations, and variance per task; project start and finish; critical ids.

properties.name: canRedo
properties.description: An undone change can be redone.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; new tasks or dependencies clear the history (expansion of known summaries is kept).

methods.name: setScale
methods.description: Change the scale, keeping the first visible date; emits aui-scale-change.

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.description: Expand or collapse a summary task (emits aui-expand-change).

methods.name: scrollToTask
methods.signature: scrollToTask(id: string, options?: { focus?: boolean }): void
methods.description: Expand the ancestors, scroll the row and bar into view, and focus the row (unless focus is false).

methods.name: scrollToDate
methods.description: Center the timeline on a date.

methods.name: moveTask
methods.description: Change the requested start (next working day). Emits aui-task-change; false when refused or cancelled.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Change the duration in working days (0 = milestone).

methods.name: addDependency
methods.description: Add a dependency (validated; throws GANTT_OPTIONS for cycles or summary tasks); false when the event is cancelled.

methods.name: resourceLoad
methods.signature: resourceLoad(range?: { start: PlainDate; end: PlainDate }): GanttResourceLoad[]
methods.description: Daily load per resource (default: the timeline range).

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undo the last change (emits aui-task-change with reason 'undo').

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove listeners and the rendered chart.

events.name: aui-task-change
events.detail: { reason: 'move' | 'resize' | 'link' | 'unlink' | 'undo' | 'redo'; changes: GanttTaskChange[]; dependency: GanttDependency | null; tasks: GanttTask[]; dependencies: GanttDependency[]; schedule: GanttSchedule }
events.description: Before a change is applied; preventDefault() keeps the previous state.

events.name: aui-expand-change
events.description: A summary task was expanded or collapsed.

events.name: aui-scale-change
events.description: The scale changed (zoom buttons or setScale).

contentAreas.name: none
contentAreas.description: Rows and bars render task data; no custom content slots.

cssClasses.name: aui-gantt | --editable | --linking | --day | --week | --month | --rtl
cssClasses.description: Host and modifiers; --aui-gantt-table-width, --aui-gantt-height, --aui-gantt-tier size the chart (--aui-gantt-row and --aui-gantt-day are set by the component).
